text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting solid single-digit gains, with Ethereum outpacing Bitcoin slightly, suggesting some appetite for altcoin risk despite the Fear & Greed index sitting at 25. Bitcoin dominance holding above 56% combined with $74B in 24-hour volume indicates participation is present, though the extreme fear reading and recent uptick in fear metrics suggest this bounce is occurring into weakness rather than conviction. The modest gains across major alts like BNB and SOL paired with elevated fear suggests traders are cautiously testing support levels rather than capitulating or entering new positions aggressively.
